definition: Encounter nodes require original-source evidence of actual shared space, in-person farewell, or direct mutual visual acknowledgment. A narrated flashback can be a true earlier in-person event but is explicitly tagged. Mere thoughts, mention, third-party description, absent person, phone about them and retrospective reference are not direct encounter nodes.

encounters.source_scope: Only direct Dhika/Chotu co-presence or a narrated in-person flashback. This is not a certification of all individual action beats.
